subsystems.name: Acceptance checker core (--verify-all)
subsystems.evidence: 13/13 unit tests pass; real tree exits 1 with 241/253 NOT_STARTED and honest reasons. 11/11 fabrication probes in throwaway repos give VERIFIED + CRUCIBLE_5_COMPLETE; on a clone of the real repo, keeping only one fabricated entry makes the real CLI exit 0 with CRUCIBLE_5_COMPLETE (probe_checker_fool.log, P12/P13).

never compares manifest ids/text/criteria/tests with manifest.derive()/requirements.py; criteria_history[0] can be rewritten silently (checker.py:84-89)
tests and implementation_files lists are not change-controlled (P10)
trusts evidence tree.clean/commit/produced_by/author fields written by the producer (checker.py:126-129, evidence.py:93-94)

staleness only for listed files, all of which are empty; transitive imports ignored (checker.py:134-139)
dependencies never checked; no finiteness check on metrics (Infinity passes); no INCOMPLETE_BLOCKED status; no placeholder detection

But (1) the agent-visible 4.0 world.help 'errors' text changed (new 'media_error:' line with no meaning) because load_all_modules now imports all v5 packages (42 -> 89 kernel modules); (2) the recorded D-19 / Clarification 2 default flip collides with 4.0 protocol call sites that rely on the default (research/protocols.py:362,623; research/learners/training.py:103,163) and with legacy_check comparing against the default constructor (experience/leakage.py:536,541); (3) the sealed salt and the only sealed set are on non-volume container storage with no backup; (4) experience.registry.make(1, <test-split family>) builds training envs on 4.0 held-out families with no split guard or exposure accounting.

overturned_subsystems.name: v5 test-suite integrity
overturned_subsystems.why: The v5 gate suite was never run in the audit (regression used --ignore=tests/v5). Running it: see gate_suite. test_C_3 fails at an integration point (social/recsys/service.py:184 expects crucible.population.register_activity; it only exists as population.core.register_activity) and has a latent crash behind it (test_gate_C.py:238 int() of a dict). SP-4.8's criterion metric hardcoded_social_revenue_bonuses stays 0 under a real +50% bonus. D-14/D-15 now formally supersede the stand-in partial worlds the social/commerce/population gates are built on.

overturned_requirements.why: Fabricated or environment-substituted evidence is VERIFIED even with an honest asserting test (S1); needs verifier re-execution, not repairs to the producer-trusting checker.

Too harsh: experience/leakage.py:511 legacy_check already loads c07098b and compares 11 env/learner paths (11/11 identical, 6.2 s) and is wired into gates R and SP-11.3; the 1,076-node 4.0 baseline JUnit exists. Work: call it from test_gate_A against explicit legacy mode and add content hashes of definitions plus agent-visible help/tool text.

criteria_weak_corrections.why: unverified_requirements == 0 is met by an all-zero record and by a pruned manifest; needs requirements_checked == len(derive()).
Counts report files; an empty 'Skeptic review' heading passes. Require cited probe logs that exist and hash-match.

additional_findings: 50/253 manifest entries (20%) are fully met by a record whose every metric is 0/False under the checker's own criterion_met (A.4, C.5, D.2, D.5, E.3, E.5, I.4, J.5, K.6, M.5, O.2-O.3, P.2-P.5, R.1, R.2, R.4, S.6, T.5, T.7, T.8, V.8, W.2, W.5-W.9, X.1-X.9, F.n1, I.n2, L.n1, N.n1, O.n1, S.n1, SP-5.4, SP-12.3, SP-16, RP.1, RP.4); none has a coverage (>= N) metric.
evidence.record() accepts +/-inf (evidence.py:86 rejects only NaN despite saying 'finite'); the checker accepts inf >= 1e9, -inf <= 0.01, p = -1 and accuracy 1.5.

verify_all never checks that the working tree equals a verified commit: an uncommitted breaking edit to a listed implementation file leaves the requirement VERIFIED (Part 21: 'final integrated implementation is committed').

4.0 open-world digests differ between two runs of the same commit (cloud.usage records measured cpu_ms, services/cloud.py:212-215), so A.5 reproduction_mismatches == 0 is undefined for open worlds until D-20; an initial c07098b-vs-HEAD digest difference was withdrawn as evidence for this reason.

Sealed salt and the only 4.0 sealed set (ow-final) exist only in /root/.crucible on non-volume storage; no backup in /workspace/backups; a recycle permanently loses the 4.0 final evaluation (A.4, RP.4).

First full v5 gate-suite run (minus H, GPU hidden): C-K 47/52 passed; L-SP first 40/62: 34 passed. 77 of 87 measured requirements already meet their manifest criteria in purpose-built partial worlds (stand-in populations, scripted creators, rule-based adopters); only implementation_files and a review string stand between them and VERIFIED, although D-14 records the subsystems are not one world.
